author: Naoya Mimura
quote: The button stopped working, so it's now unusable.
paraphrase: Bag broke a month after purchase when its button failed.

author: Heather Behl
quote: I never received the item or was contacted back by customer service.
paraphrase: Item never arrived despite company claiming delivered; no support reply.

author: Meg Hann
quote: I have been now trying to contact Nordace for multiple days to try and go through the exchange process
paraphrase: Tried for days to exchange a bag that was too big, no response.

author: Demelza St George
quote: it's well made - apart from the shoulder straps!!! When you're lugging this bag through the airport
paraphrase: Likes capacity and build but unpadded shoulder straps so painful she stopped using it.

author: Martha Broussard
quote: I purchased the Sienna Backpack for a vacation, it lasted less than ten days before ripping.
paraphrase: Sienna Backpack tore within days of a trip; holds less than advertised.

author: Mrs Jo Tilden
quote: Nordace's website states that if you are not fully satisfied, you can return or exchange your purchase
paraphrase: 30-day return promise undermined by unclear answers about refunds/restocking fees on unused gift bag.

author: RD
quote: This site claims they ship your order within 24 hours. 100% false.
paraphrase: Order took about a week to get tracking.

author: mair Jones
quote: I tried on 3 separate occasions to return it; completed the refund information 3 times within the refund window
paraphrase: Three return attempts produced only automated emails; window closed.

author: Lynley Harvey
quote: I have not received my refund despite them admitting they had received my return
paraphrase: Refund not received weeks after return confirmed.

author: Dodge
quote: I have contacted them asking for a refund and now they won't answer!
paraphrase: Purse never delivered; refund requests unanswered.

author: Dee Bonner
quote: This is way overpriced , larger then I wanted .. I would have returned if u took returns
paraphrase: Overpriced and too large; would have returned.

author: M Silva
quote: they want me to pay for the return costs.
paraphrase: Bag late and looked cheap; asked to pay return shipping despite 30-day promise.

author: Ann Kenney
quote: After several emails, I was informed that an exchange would cost me $50.
paraphrase: Exchanging a Siena Pro 17 backpack that was too large cost $50.

author: Linda Zell
quote: The product did not come with a return label.
paraphrase: Couldn't find out how to return; out more than $80.
